mapper.select: SELECT q.QUOTE_ID, q.QUOTE_NO, q.STATUS, q.CONTACT_NAME, q.CONTACT_PHONE, q.COMPANY_NAME, q.ESTIMATE_DATE, q.APPROVED_AT, q.REQUEST_ID, q.MEMBER_ID, v.FILE_PATH AS VIDEO_PATH, v.FILE_NAME AS VIDEO_NAME, v.UPLOADED_AT AS VIDEO_UPLOADED_AT FROM TBL_QUOTE q LEFT JOIN (SELECT REQUEST_ID, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, UPLOADED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REQUEST_ID ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM TBL_RE_VIDEO) v ON v.REQUEST_ID = q.REQUEST_ID AND v.RN = 1 WHERE q.STATUS != '04' ORDER BY q.ESTIMATE_DATE DESC, q.QUOTE_ID DESC
SELECT * FROM TBL_QUOTE_ITEM WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
SELECT * FROM TBL_QUOTE_OPTION WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId} ORDER BY OPTION_CODE
mapper.sql: COMPANY_NAME = #{companyName}, CONTACT_NAME = #{contactName}, CONTACT_PHONE = #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ESTIMATE_DATE = #{estimateDate}, FROM_ADDRESS = #{fromAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_ADDRESS = #{toAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_DATE = #{workDate,jdbcType=DATE}, TRANSPORT_DATE = #{transportDate,jdbcType=DATE}, WORK_TYPE = #{workType,jdbcType=CHAR}, FROM_LADDER_USE = #{fromLadderUse}, TO_LADDER_USE = #{toLadderUse}, FROM_ELEVATOR_USE = #{fromElevatorUse}, TO_ELEVATOR_USE = #{toElevatorUse}, FROM_STAIRS_USE = #{fromStairsUse}, TO_STAIRS_USE = #{toStairsUse}, VOLUME_TON = #{volumeTon,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NOTE = #{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOVING_COST = #{movingCost,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FROM_LADDER_FLOOR = #{fromLadderFloor,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FROM_LADDER_COST = #{fromLadderCost}, TO_LADDER_FLOOR = #{toLadderFloor,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_LADDER_COST = #{toLadderCost}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = #{depositAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, BALANCE_AMOUNT = #{balanceAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ITEM_GROUP1 = #{itemGroup1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ITEM_GROUP2 = #{itemGroup2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ITEM_GROUP3 = #{itemGroup3,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ITEM_GROUP4 = #{itemGroup4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_QUOTE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_QUOTE (QUOTE_ID, QUOTE_NO, REQUEST_ID, MEMBER_ID, ADMIN_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, STATUS, COMPANY_NAME, CONTACT_NAME, ESTIMATE_DATE, FROM_LADDER_USE, TO_LADDER_USE, FROM_ELEVATOR_USE, TO_ELEVATOR_USE, FROM_STAIRS_USE, TO_STAIRS_USE, FROM_LADDER_COST, TO_LADDER_COST, DOCUMENT_PATH, APPROVED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{quoteId}, 'QT-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(#{quoteId}, 10000), 4, '0'), #{requestId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{companyName}, #{contactName}, #{estimateDate}, 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 0, 0, #{documentPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{status} = '01' THEN NULL ELSE SYSDATE END, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QUOTE SET , UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QUOTE_ITEM (QT_ITEM_ID, QUOTE_ID, CATEGORY, ITEM_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (SEQ_QUOTE_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{quoteId}, #{category}, #{itemName}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO TBL_QUOTE_OPTION (QT_OPTION_ID, QUOTE_ID, OPTION_CODE, CHOICE1_YN, CHOICE2_YN, OPTION_COST) VALUES (SEQ_QUOTE_OPTION.NEXTVAL, #{quoteId}, #{optionCode}, #{choice1Yn}, #{choice2Yn}, #{optionCost})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QUOTE SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}

UPDATE TBL_QUOTE SET STATUS = '02', APPROVED_AT = SYSDATE, EXPIRES_AT = SYSDATE + 30, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, ADMIN_ID = NVL(#{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ADMIN_ID) WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId} AND STATUS = '01'
